articleTitle: Laboratory setup with squirrel-cage motors for wind turbine emulation
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper presents a laboratory setup to be used as a wind turbine emulator. The emulator can be used for research investigation by reproducing the mechanical torque developed by a wind turbine for a given wind speed and angular velocity, thus driving an electrical generator in a similar way to a wind turbine. Ensuring repeatable testing conditions allows for comparison of different wind turbine control algorithms. In the presentad solution, the turbine torque is reproduced by an AC drive with a squirrel cage motor coupled with the AC generator on the common shaft. A frequency converter that controls the emulator motor operates in the torque control mode. The command for the converter, proportional to the emulated instantaneous turbine torque, is calculated as the output from a wind turbine mathematical model running in the real time on PC in the Matlab-Simulink environment. Experimental results recorded for standardized wind gusts are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the quality of uninterruptible power supply using a UPS
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper discusses the problem of the quality of electric current, indicating its disadvantages. Based on them, using the FTA method, a power failure tree diagram was developed. The simplest methods of hardware prevention of low power quality occurrence are shown. In this case, a power failure tree was also developed using the same method. The obtained results were compared and discussed.

articleTitle: Quantum computing for clustering big datasets
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The authors present the technology of quantum computing along with examples of two quantum computers - IBM-Q and D-Wave. Preliminary results of a novel method of data clustering suitable for implementing on adiabatic quantum computer are also inluded. They show that the proposed method works on small datasets.

articleTitle: The reaction of garden cress (Lepidium sativum L. to microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The aim of the study was to investigate the influence of microwaves with the frequency of 2.45 GHz on the process of the garden cress germination. The study was carried out in 2017 in laboratory conditions. The study focused on seeds of garden cress (Lepidium sativum). The seeds, put on the Petri dish, were irradiated with 2.45 GHz microwaves for 5-15 seconds then germinated. It has been demonstrated that the irradiation of the garden cress seeds had a modifying impact on the germination capability. On the assumed materiality level the statistically significant influence of microwaves on the germination capability and the seed germination rate was not found.

articleTitle: Assessment of the potential of using photon emission to identify selected qualitative features of organic matter
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The research attempts to determine the possibility of using the phenomenon of secondary luminescence of organic matter to assess its properties, which are important from the point of view of food quality parameterization. In order to conduct the experiment, a measuring station equipped with a photomultiplier was used to identify individual photons emitted by organic matter. There was a difference in the number of photons recorded by the photon measuring system within selected groups of food products, this statement concerns the final products and components constituting their recipe. It has been observed that there is a practical possibility of differentiating organic matter in terms of the degree of photon emission.

articleTitle: Prognosis of the electromagnetic field parameters of numerically controlled machine tools in industrial conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The problem of high-frequency electromagnetic field at the workplace is critical due to its effect on the operators of technological machines. For this reason, the exposure to electromagnetic fields at the workplace should be subject to regular monitoring. The paper presents the use of simple models for forecasting of magnetic and electric fields components. This study investigates the high-frequency electromagnetic field emitted in CNC machine tools area (DMU 65 Mono Block). Experimental tests were conducted for CNC machine tool. The measurements of high-frequency electric field strength were performed in compliance with the method specified in the PN-T- 06580–3: 2002 standard.

articleTitle: Cooperation of the Process of Charging the Electric Vehicle With the Photovoltaic Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the structure of electric vehicles in Europe, their expansion, participation in the transport sector and the prospect of development. The work shows the types of solar carports construction using photovoltaic technology. The article shows the possibility of charging electric cars with the help of solar carports, showing car parks as a place of connection electromobility and green energy production. Presents the impact of solar carport on the operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Application of natural luminescence for assessment of hard coal quality
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The research attempts to determine the possibility of using the phenomenon of natural luminescence of matter to evaluate the quality of coal. For the experiment, a measuring station equipped with a photomultiplier was used to identify photons emitted by optically piqued matter. The process of measuring the number of photons emitted was performed automatically, to which the LabView programming environment was used. There was a difference in the number of photons within the tested groups of coal. It has been observed that there is a practical possibility of differentiating matter in terms of photon emission levels.

articleTitle: Fuzzy logic controller for robot manipulator control system
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the results of simulation tests on the use of a fuzzy system in the controller of an anthropomorphic manipulator with a drive in the form of permanent magnet synchronous motors.

articleTitle: Detection of outliers in the financial time series using ARIMA models
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The subject of this work is a comparative analysis of selected models used to describe the volatility of financial time series with attention to the problem of exceptions. According to the definition provided by Moore and McCabe in 1999 [3], in statistics, outliers are the observations that fall outside the overall pattern of a distribution. This paper describes common approaches to detecting outliers, modelling dataset describing real-world processes in financial area and making forecast. Based on the approach indicated by A. J. Fox in 1972, this subject focuses on using the selected ARIMA models for forecasting the future value of data set which containing outliers. The studies showed that the typical features of financial time series are the so- called grouped variances. Therefore, using ARIMA models for forecasting was insufficient, as data with effect of grouping variances requires models considering these effects, like ARCH, GARCH.

articleTitle: The intensity of the electromagnetic fields in the coverage of GSM 900, GSM 1800 DECT, UMTS, WLAN in built-up areas
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Research was carried out in several locations - in the cities of Lublin, Chelm, Kielce, Bełżec, Orłów Murowana and Stryjów in the period of March-May 2018. High frequencies research was using the ESM-140 meters. The ESM-140 measures the electric field strength for high frequencies such as 900MHz (GSM900), 1750MHz (GSM1800), DECT, 1950MHz (UMTS), 2440MHz (WLAN). The measurements were taken both in buildings and in the open, urbanized area.

articleTitle: Torque speed characteristics of torsional torque generator for supporting drilling processes
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: In this project a novel research into the use of torsional torque with frequencies close or equal to the natural frequency of mined rock to improve the efficiency of drilling will be carried out. In proposed solution, pulsating torque using an electromagnetic torsional generator is produced. Such equipment could be used to drill a tunnel through solid rock or rubble to reach potentially trapped miners with an additional advantage of reduced size and weight compared to conventional drilling rigs. In this article will also be presented the so-called torque- speed characteristics of a new type of electromagnetic device called torsional torque generator. These characteristics will be determined using FEM methods.

articleTitle: Reduction of electromagnetic disturbances emission generated by LED lighting fixture
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The work deal with the requirements fulfilment in the field of electromagnetic compatibility by manufactured electrical equipment. The results of compatibility tests of the LED luminaire and ways to approach the device compliance with the requirements of the standards are described.

articleTitle: Application of natural luminescence for analysis of the radionuclide migration path during hard coal combustion
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The research attempts to determine the possibility of using the phenomenon of natural luminescence of matter to evaluate the radionuclide transfer pathway in coal combustion processes. For the experiment, a measuring station equipped with a photomultiplier was used to identify photons emitted by optically piqued matter. The process of measuring the number of photons emitted was performed automatically, to which the LabView programming environment was used. There was a difference in the number of photons within the tested groups of coal combustion products, this statement concerns the final products and components constituting their mixtures. It has been observed that there is a practical possibility of differentiating matter in terms of photon emission levels.

articleTitle: Memristors — the principle of operation and the areas of applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The memristor is not commonly known passive element of electric circuits. The selected physical realisations of this element as well as its operation in an electric circuit have been presented. Additionally, the memristors were also described with regards to the areas of their applications.

articleTitle: Architecture of a mobile system for the analysis of biomedical signals based on electrical tomography
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: In this article we describe the system modeling of an advanced electrical tomography platform for biomedical use. The tomographic data acquisition needs to be as fast as reliable to incorporate tomographic inversion algorithms with almost real time update. To provide high level application programming interfaces using standard communication protocols and execute level programs System architecture and prototype designs for a biomedical electrical tomography platform are presented. Implementation details are explained for two prototype devices: a separated FPGA/microcontroller system and a system chip containing hardware microprocessor, peripherals and FPGA.

articleTitle: Effective ultrasound and radio tomography imaging algorithm for three-dimensional problems
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: This article presents a new effective imaging method that can be applied in ultrasonic and radio tomography. The same algorithms can be implemented in these fields. The proposed method by changing the shape of the voxels leads to a substantial simplification of the algorithm at the cost of small approximations. As proved in the work, these approximations do not have a significant impact on the readability of the image which is several times faster.

articleTitle: Classification of data streams containing abnormal information
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: One fundamental task for streaming analytics is not only to model each stream in an unsupervised fashion but detect unusual, anomalous behaviors in real-time. The growing attention of the data mining techniques and outlier detection methods pushed authors to examine the usefulness of them in economic data. In paper we present k-NN and C4.5 algorithms for classification streaming data. We present our research for five investment fund. As a result (For analyse investments fund), the K-nearest neighbour algorithm with k=1 achieved the best results for forecasting the value for the further investment funds listening.

articleTitle: Electrical Stimulation Therapy History And Contemporary Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper deals with the problems which are evoked by electric stimulation of human in the process of physiotherapy. Some historical background has been showed as well as the contemporary applications have been described. Special attention has been paid to the quite new applications, namely the electric stimulation of tips. Results of the medical treatments (case studies) are presented.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the use of autonomous driving systems and identification of spatial diversity of selected soil parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the possibilities of using telematic systems in the food production process. It describes technical possibilities and the changes in technology resulting from them as well as minimization of human work. In addition, the benefits resulting from the minimization of outlays and the precision of individual treatments and, consequently, the entire production were indicated.

articleTitle: Distributed system architecture for the remote monitoring of a flood embankment
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents research related to the design of a dispersed, multi-sensor system for monitoring flood embankments. Designing and creating such a system is not an easy task, because it consists of knowledge and experience from many fields. One can mention the use of electrical tomography for non-invasive observation of objects such as floods or industrial tanks. The monitoring system includes various types of sensors and meters used to determine, for example, wind strength, ambient temperature, but in this work the authors focused mainly on the use of electrical tomography. The operation of the system is based on observing the environment using various types of intelligent measurement methods, but also on an analytical system based on computational intelligence algorithms used for data analysis and visualization. An important part of the system is a platform that provides devices with interfaces for data exchange, collection and storage of historical data, ensuring access to data by analytical systems.

articleTitle: Application of a neural EIT system to control the processes
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: This study presents the original Electrical Impedence Tomography (EIT) imaging method in relation to physico-chemical processes. Thanks to the developed method using artificial neural networks, we managed to create an algorithm that would allow effective detection of crystals and inclusions in the reactor filled with non-Newtonian fluid. The neural controller consists of a system of separately trained neural networks, the number of which corresponds to the resolution of the output image lattice.

articleTitle: Optimization of SAR coefficient for dipole antennas array with regard to local hyperthermia
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper considers the optimization issue of eight dipole antennas array surrounding the tested object. The goal was to maximize the specific absorption rate (SAR) in the target volume, while minimizing the same parameter in the outer object. The SAR optimization was prepared by means of the powers (amplitudes) and the phases used to excite the individual antenna elements of the array. Presented consideration may have a great importance in tumor targeted thermal therapy.

articleTitle: Position for calibrating resistance strain gauges
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the construction of a measuring station to determine the characteristics of strain gauges in a way that enables the analysis of the process of scaling in real time with simultaneous data archiving. The strain force of strain gauges was measured using three independent measuring methods. The strain gauges were calibrated by means of sensors coupled with the software and the measurement results were archived and visualized on the monitor screen. There were no statistically significant differences between the characteristics of the tested strain gauge determined by different measurement methods, which indicates full functionality of all measurement methods used in the modernized station.

articleTitle: Influence of variable electromagnetic field on the energy and germination capacity of Cannabis sativa L. subsp. culta Serebr
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: In the study, seed material of cannabis was used. In the experiment, a solenoid emitting variable electromagnetic field was used. Seeds were subject to the effect of the field at two values of induction: 50 and 70 mT. On each occasion, the exposure time was 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210 and 240 min. Moreover, control samples were prepared not exposed to the field. Seed germination was performed on Petri dishes on the medium of filtration paper moistened with distilled water. The obtained experimental results demonstrated absence of influence of variable electromagnetic field on germination energy and capacity of cannabis seeds. However, this factor revealed its influence in terms of the number of correctly developed seedlings. Seeds exposed to electromagnetic field with induction of 70 mT, independently of the exposure time, produced significantly higher number of correctly developed seedlings compared to the zero sample. Similar regularity was also found with lower field induction value (50 mT), yet in this case exposure time was of importance as well.

articleTitle: Challenges in differentiating between attention disorders based on EEG recordings in neurofeedback therapy
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The aim of this article is to show problems with the analysis of various cognitive disorders in the registered EEG signal and the effects of the neurofeedback therapy. Most of the disorders tested in ICD-10 have electroencephalographic readings associated with Beta bands and slow waves. All problems with attention deficit have similar records in the EEG signal and similar training protocols are used in their therapy and the results of the therapy are visible in more than 10 training sessions.

articleTitle: Assessment of pilling effect on the laser modified textile substrates
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The purpose of the work was to determine the impact of the modification of a textile substrate by using a laser beam on the susceptibility of textile products to pilling. The nondestructive method of optical coherence tomography was used to evaluate the tendency to form an unsightly ball of fibers or knots. A positive effect of laser processing on the decreasing number of slacken individual threads protruding above the surface of the fabric was observed, and as a result the reduction of the created pills.

articleTitle: The prototype ultrasound tomography device to analyze the properties of processes
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Ultrasound tomography gives the possibility to analyze processes taking place inside the facility without disturbing the production, analysis and detection of obstacles, defects and various anomalies. The presented measuring system has a specially designed measuring structure (including electrodes, thanks to which it is an innovative solution in the field, particularly effective in analysis). Knowledge of the characteristics of each tomographic technique solution, the application allows you to choose the appropriate method of image reconstruction. Inverse problem is the process of identifying optimization or synthesis, wherein the objective is to determine the parameters describing the data field.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effectiveness of the prototype PV tracking system
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: A prototype pico control system for the photovoltaic (PV) power plant was constructed in a follow-up movement after the position of the sun, where position adjustment takes place in two planes. The principle of operation is based on comparing the voltage values from small PV modules constituting the measurement system. Using this stand, the dynamics of changes in light intensity as a function of electric energy production using a PV cell was analyzed. The results of the study were compared with a stationary photovoltaic cell. The correctness of the PV follow-up operation was assessed.

articleTitle: Impact of pulsed electric field on the colour of wine made from grapes Marechal Foch variety
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The colour of wine is one of the key indicators of its quality. The influence of impulse electric field PEF on grapes, which will be used for wine production, is still a novel issue on a global scale. Grapes (Marechal Foch variety) were subjected to a pulsed electric field for 10 s, at a frequency of 20 pulses per second and two values of electric field strength of 3.3 kV/cm and 5 kV/cm, followed by fermentation in accordance with the procedures used in the wine industry. In the produced wines, the colour was determined using the CIELab method, obtaining L, * a, * b values, which are the axes of a three-dimensional colour space. It has been shown that the pulsed electric field PEF has a positive effect on the colour of red wine. The share of red parameter (*a) in wines (WMF 2, WMF 3) is respectively higher by 15% and 24% in relation to wine produced in typical conditions without additional pretreatment (WMF 1). The obtained results indicate a higher productivity of extraction of colour compounds from grapes under the influence of PEF. This is beneficial because the more intense wine colour correlates with the higher content of coloured antioxidant pro-health compounds.

articleTitle: Analysis of methods for measuring earth resistance and soil resistivity
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Measurement of earth resistance is the basic measurement in the evaluation of the effectiveness of protection against indirect contact in the TT network system, using automatic power off as a protection measure. It is also necessary in assessing the effectiveness of lightning protection. The article describes the characteristics of the methods used to measure the resistance and resistivity of the soil, as well as the principles of measurements. The authors also assessed the effect of various soil types on the effectiveness of earthing.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Field Calculations of Multimodule Electromechanical Device for Drilling Process - Main Motor Calculations
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The key motivation of project Information Driven Incident Response - INDIRES - is the provision of the vital information - often under non-ideal conditions - that is required to facilitate the planning and operation of a response to a serious underground incident that could threaten the lives of miners and of the future operation and profitability of the mine. Such rapid access to information has never previously been achievable under adverse conditions. The paper presents results of electromagnetic field calculations for part - main motor - of multimodule electromechanical device for drilling process. The calculations were used in design process of this machine.

articleTitle: A hybrid tomography system for the analysis of wall dampness
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents an innovative solution for assessing the moisture level of walls and building condition. The use of modern tomographic techniques will allow for a nondestructive and non-destructive very precise spatial assessment of the humidity level. The proposed application solves the inverse problem in electrical tomography. Prepared constructions contain special electrodes for measuring humidity in a brick wall. The level set method was used to reconstruct the images.

articleTitle: The use of multisensor electrodes in ERT for area monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: This paper presents a non-destructive method with the use of multisector electrodes for testing objects such as landfills and flood embankments. Special sensors for depth measurements with the use of electrical resistance tomography have been developed. It is an innovative solution for testing water reservoirs, both in terms of the measurement method and the reconstruction model. The use of tomographic techniques in combination with reconstructive algorithms will allow noninvasive and very accurate spatial assessment of humidity and damages of flood embankments.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of cathodic protection for traction poles
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Electrochemical corrosion is the main cause of the degradation of the underground steel infrastructure. Its control, repair and maintenance spend increasing amounts, which is a serious economic problem. One of the most effective methods of protection against electrochemical corrosion is the cathodic protection. The paper proposes modeling of the galvanic protection system of the underground section of the construction of traction poles made of R35 type steel. The main purpose of this study is to use simulation tools to design optimal cathodic protection systems and determine the distribution of potential and current density on Uuried construction surfaces.

articleTitle: Influence of pulsed electric field on the content of polyphenolic compounds in wine
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Grapes (Marechal Foch varieties) were subjected to the pulsed electric field (PEF) for 10 s, at a frequency of 20 pulses per second and two values of electrical field strength: 3.3 kV/cm and 5 kV/cm. Then grape fermentation was carried out according to the procedures used in the wine industry for 8 weeks. In the obtained wines, the total polyphenolic compounds were determined (they were converted into gallic acid equivalent (GAE) per 1 dm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> wine (GAmg/dm3). The total content of polyphenolic compounds in the obtained wines is from 897 (WMF P1) to 997 (WMF P3) GAmg/dm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. As it results from the study the pulsed electric field has a positive influence on the polyphenol content in obtained wine. The usage of a pulsed electric field in pre-treatment of grapes results in increasing the polyphenol content by 10% during the extraction and fermentation process. No significant influence of the applied intensity was found (3.3 kV/cm, 5 kV/cm) on the polyphenol content. The obtained results indicate a higher efficiency of extraction of antioxidants from grapes under the influence of PEF. Because polyphenolic compounds are health-promoting then higher content of them is beneficial for people. Moreover, they affect the more intense wine colour.

articleTitle: Analytical Approach to Boundary Integral Formulation for the Laplace/Poisson Equations in Circular Regions
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: A use of boundary integral equation (BIE) in solving the boundary problems in such 2D domains like circles and rings is considered in the paper. By expanding the excitation and the solution into the Fourier series, the problem is reduced to purely algebraic for each angular harmonic. The fundamental solutions for each harmonic are determined for the Laplace equation. Examples of use of the reduced BIE are given. Analysis for various combinations of boundary conditions is performed. One of the consequences is explaining the reason why the conventional boundary element method (BEM) crashes when solving the Laplace equation in a circle of unit radius (degenerate scale problem). As a kind of by-product, some definite integrals were found.

articleTitle: Control and diagnostics of an AC servo drive in selected operation modes
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper presents the construction and general working principle of an AC servo drive. The component parts of the servo amplifier circuits are described and the mathematical dependences relevant for the operation of a synchronous motor with permanent magnets are given. Besides, control modes and selected parameters of the servo drive are characterized. A number of measuring experiments were carried out on the system during acceleration and deceleration in a prescribed speed range. The results of measurements are presented as curves of the command position, feedback position, rotational speed and phase current versus time.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction for Human Cell Nuclei in Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The state-of-the-art in color coding is presented and standardized machine vision-based nuclei detection procedure is proposed. Nuclei detection effectiveness measurement algorithm is presented and results are discussed. The conclusion is drawn and future work areas are indicated.

articleTitle: Signals for magnetic field therapy and a method for their preparation
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents signals used for physical therapy and rehabilitation for use in medical facilities and at home. The way of their implementation was discussed. The controller model with a touch panelwas presented and its functions discussed.

articleTitle: Inverter with 280 kHz frequency to induction levitation of metal melting in a vacuum
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Levitating metal melting is an attractive solution for metallurgists because the heated metal charge floats levitatively in a vacuum without touching any material, in contrast to what happens in the inductive crucible melting where the metal touches the walls of the crucible. Such levitation melting of the metal does not introduce external impurities, and its additional feature is mixing the molten mass during the process. The paper presents an inverter built for levitation metal melting, visualization of the results of electrical measurements made and a technical solution for keeping the metal sample in the optimal place of the device.

articleTitle: The algorithms in tracking photovoltaic systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The main goal of the article is to present methods for controlling the positioning of solar panels in relation to the position of the Sun. The article presents the division of follow-up systems and selected algorithms for their control. The presented algorithms using the control and executive system orientate the surface of the module, optimally to the direction of the sun through the use of the control and executive system. Thanks to the applied position regulation, which takes place at a specific time interval, an average up to 40% more energy can be obtained compared to the fixed solar panels.

articleTitle: The Impact of a Wind Turbine Characteristics on the Annual Energy Performance at Given Wind Speed Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of an analysis of the impact of fitting the rotor and generator characteristics of a small wind turbine to the Weibull wind speed distribution. For testing purposes, three theoretical characteristics of wind turbines differing in the location of the nominal point were adopted. It was assumed that the shape of the rotor characteristics corresponded to the shape of the mechanical characteristics of developed switched reluctance generators. The maximum power of the rotors was obtained at given wind speeds. The studies were carried out using simulation methods. All generator simulation models adopted for the tests were based on the same magnetic circuits and differed only in the parameters of their windings. As a result, energy performance for various rotor-generator configurations was calculated and the radii of the rotors were determined to obtain the required nominal power.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis of Topological Derivative for Electrical Impedance Tomography
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the reconstruction of the 2D objects studied using the topological derivative and the level set function in the electrical impedance tomography, which is a non- invasive imaging method, where an unknown physical object is examined using measurements on its edge. The internal distribution of conductivity is recovered from the measured data. The solution to the optimization problem is obtained by combining the finite element method and topological algorithms. The presented solution can be effectively used in applications based on electrical tomography.

articleTitle: Analysis of ultra-weak photon emission from craft beers
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Photon emission from 7 different craft beers manufactured for “Trzech Kumpli” brewery was analyzed. According to Popp’s hypothesis, the quality of food can be significantly related to the optimal and characteristic level of photon emissions from the food products. The analysis of the correlation between the intensity of photon emission and the percentage of alcohol, extract as well as the degree of bitterness of tested beers expressed in IBU was carried out. The intensity of photon emission during the measurements was also analyzed. Statistically significant differentiation in photon emission was found within analyzed beer, while the intensity of photon emission was at a similar level during the measurements. The correlation coefficient R between the predicted number of emitted photons and the percentage of alcohol, extract or degree of bitterness was 0.8637, 0.7926 and 0.9820, respectively.

articleTitle: The method of noise reduction in systems with two signals paths
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The publication presents a method for interference and noise reduction in antenna arrays systems, mainly applicable in radio communication, microwave systems, radars, where there are at least two signal paths and there is a need to reduce interference with different phases or amplitudes. The research used the method described in Polish patent PL-226101 “Method of noise and noise reduction in systems with two signal paths and phase filter” and obtained positive results. This invention relates to a simple and very effective method of eliminating noises and interferences, mainly in diversity receiving systems (antenna arrays), where eliminates all pairs of signals with different phases or different amplitudes and passes only signals with similar phases and amplitudes. The solution allows to strongly increase directional of antenna arrays and reduce the noise significantly and thereby maximize the signal-to-noise ratio (S/N).

articleTitle: Using Natural and Modified Waste Rocks for Phenol Removal from Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: A possibility of using natural and modified waste rocks to remove phenol from industrial wastewater is considered in the paper. Sorption of phenol was carried out in laboratory conditions by means of static sorption in synthetic solutions with initial phenol concentrations comparable with concentrations of this compound in industrial wastewater. The waste rocks accompanying coal seams were taken from three mines (denoted as M1, M2 and M3) located in the southern part of Poland. Raw and calcined rocks at 400 °C, 600 °C and 800 °C were examined. The research results indicate that the waste rocks collected from the mines differ in their sorption properties for phenol. The maximum amount of adsorbed phenol for raw gangue samples was 55 cmol/kg (M1), 35 cmol/kg (M2) and 45 cmol/kg (M3). The thermal treatment in 400 °C or 600 °C caused an increase in the maximum phenol uptake on average by up to 70%. However, modification at 800 °C resulted in lowering the sorption capacity.

articleTitle: Assessment of the electromagnetic hazards associated with the occurrence of the contact current while using radiotelephones
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The electromagnetic field is a commonly appearing factor. One of the effects of exposing humans as conductive objects to an electromagnetic field is the induction of the electromagnetic field, and the electric current, inside their bodies. They can lead to the electrostimulation of excitable cells and even to thermal damage. The text introduces policies on measuring the contact currents for the sake of safety and hygiene of labour while use of mobile radiotelephones is being employed.

articleTitle: Magnetophosphenes - case study
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The aim of the article is to present the magnetophosphenes phenomenon occurring on the human retina of a person under the influence of a low frequency magnetic field. Due to the difficulty of studying this phenomenon resulting from the need to conduct an experiment on living organisms, the authors present the case studies conducted in the world.

articleTitle: Study of efficiency of tribo-electrostatic separation of finely dispersed carbon powders
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Analyzed in this study are the conditions for separation of powder materials using the tribo-electrostatic method. A project of a tribo-electrostatic air separator with a drum separator has been developed. In order to increase the efficiency of separation, an optional electrode is used, which is shipped with a negative high voltage power supply. It’s been found that using a separator allows for obtainment of three fractions of the carbon material– 1-10 microns, 10-20 microns and 20-40 microns– using electrodes with drum field strength of 38 kV/m. The test showed that the effect of vibration on the tribocharge is significant – the output of a specific fraction is three times greater than that of particles charged by friction and five to seven times greater than uncharged particles. It’s been shown that thermal processing of powders has a significant effect on the value of their tribo-electric charge. To achieve a proper distribution of the carbon materials, an initial drying with temperatures in 100-120 °C is required, which results in stable carbon mass. Obtained carbon fractions have specific efficiency; the highest capacitance was observed in materials with particle size of 1-10 microns. In comparison to original, such carbon has a ≈ 25% higher capacitance and the electrode’s resistance is ≈ 30% lower.

articleTitle: Electrical Parameters of Chosen Organs of Abdominal Cavity and Their Influence on Electromagnetic Waves Propagation
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The electrical conductivity and relative permittivity of chosen organs of abdominal cavity versus frequency for the popular ranges of VHF and LF have been presented in the article. They have been used for determining a dielectric loss angle tangent which constitutes the basis for defining the kind of medium in which the wave may be propagated. The change in the wavelength, its propagation speed in the organ and the conventional depth of the wave's penetration into particular organs were calculated.

Author Keywords: organs and tissues of abdominal cavity

articleTitle: Elastic net method in the image reconstruction infiltration of water in the embankment
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: This article proposes an algorithm based on Elastic net method in order to obtain more accurate and stable results of reconstruction in solving the inverse problem in electrical tomography in a flood embankment. To reconstruct the image in the electrical resistance tomography, a spring mesh was used, which is a combination of two methods: ridge regression and LASSO. The combination of the proposed algorithms is effective in simulation.

articleTitle: System for automatic measurement of topsoil layer compaction and its spatial identification within the research area
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the construction of a mobile measurement system enabling the measurement of selected parameters necessary to identify the compaction of the topsoil layer and software capable of collecting, processing and visualizing measured parameters in real time. The measuring system consists of independent systems measuring individual operating parameters, which were: fuel consumption, forces in the tractor three-point linkage system during the operation of the tools, the speed of the aggregate drive, slip of the right and left drive wheels of the tractor. In addition, the system is equipped with a GPS receiver that allows the positioning of the aggregate. The system was functioning correctly within the designated objective function.

articleTitle: Attenuation of High Frequency Electromagnetic Waves by Polymer Composites with Waste Materials
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Composite materials with polymers and waste materials like zinc ore, mill scale, ironwork dust are studied with respect to attenuation of electromagnetic radiation of high frequency. Samples of such composites were prepared and tested for several frequencies in X band (S-12 GHz). The composites relatively strongly attenuate electromagnetic radiation in the considered band. They could be used as material for cases of various devices that are sensitive for electromagnetic radiation. Using various waste materials has also ecological aspect.

articleTitle: What kind of impact is more important? … role of altmetrics indicators
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The purpose of the work is an invitation to discussion on the role of altmetrics indicators in the scientists' awareness. There is a discussion about Open Access (OA) publications: do they have more citations and altmetrics indicators? What kind of publications have different results and why? The authors compare articles with high, low (only one) and zero citations indexed in Scopus and Web of Science databases. Both databases were also searched by titles of the most cited journals for occupational safety and health and electromagnetics.

articleTitle: Modelling oflithium-ion batteries exploitation parameters in electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: In this work selected electrochemical battery models and analysis of its life span are discussed. In order to analyse the main lithium ion battery parameters and estimate its degradation during the discharge for batteries used in electric vehicles computer simulation was carried out and the results were presented. At the end of article the conclusions were presented.

articleTitle: Systematic temperature measurement errors, caused by heat dissipation along the shield of industrial thermometer
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical model of an industrial thermometer installed in the wall of an object (e.g. a pipeline) and analyzed systematic errors in temperature measurement caused by heat dissipation through the thermometer cover.

articleTitle: Influence of the measurement method and reconstruction algorithm in the analysis of the airbrick moisture
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Algorithm of Least Angle Regression implemented to solve the inverse problem in electrical impedance tomography for the moisture wall. The highly correlated predictors with each other's in linear models do not allow to determine the precisely influences of these predictors on the output variable. Directly application the least square method to estimate the unknown parameters may lead to a poor prediction. The addition of penalty depending on quantities of parameters to the least square criterion allows us to determine the biased estimators but also to reduce the variance of estimators.

articleTitle: Neurotherapeutic Applications of Electromagnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Increasing interest in using electromagnetic fields for therapeutic purposes is observed in, and encouraged by, basic science publications and clinical reports. Numerous publications have discussed the possibility of occurrence of the beneficial effects on various biological processes by exogenous magnetic and electromagnetic fields, which are of critical importance for the healing of different injuries and pathologies. In the presented paper, authors describe possible application of electromagnetic fields in therapeutic purposes and its prospective mechanisms of action.

articleTitle: optimization of the structure of the hybrid power plants
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the concept of software allowing to determine the optimal distribution of generating power in a hybrid power plant consisting of photovoltaic modules and wind turbines. The properties of hybrid systems using wind and solar generators are described. optimization criteria related to the selection of the structure of hybrid power plants to a given load were also discussed. Due to the nature of the optimization task, the genetic algorithm was used.

articleTitle: Selected Applications of Modern Textronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Technological progress and the miniaturization of electronics allow to develop new textronic materials that can be applied in everyday use. Textronics combines knowledge primarily in the fields of: textiles, electronics, computer science, but also from automatics, materials science and metrology. The paper presents selected textronic systems, resulting from the work of the authors. The presented examples show the perspectives of the development of textronics in such fields as medicine, consumer electronics, clothing.

articleTitle: Simulation model of the microwave-vacuum drying process of selected fruits and vegetables
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article analyzes the automatic control of the microwave-vacuum drying process of selected fruits and vegetables. The method of designing a closed control system using modeling and computer simulation is presented. Object and control system models have been developed. The essence of their operation is presented in block diagrams and charts. The correctness of operation of the created models was verified by computer simulation and results were compared to the known forms of behavior of the mapped real object.

articleTitle: Application of a distributed industrial tomography system for the analysis of technological processes
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the idea of a production process control system. Advanced automation and control of production processes play a key role in maintaining competitiveness. The proposed solution consists of a network of sensors to measure process parameters, production resources and equipment status. The system uses wired and wireless communication, which allows obtaining data from existing sensors and systems in companies, as well as obtaining data from new systems and sensors used to measure all processes, from the preparation of production to the final product. The solution includes process tomography sensors based on electrical tomography. The use of tomographic methods makes it possible to manage the intelligent structure of companies in terms of processes and products.

articleTitle: Interdisciplinary modelling of transient processes in local electric power systems including long supply lines of distributed parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Based on interdisciplinary approaches to modelling that use a modified Hamilton-Ostrogradsky principle, a mathematical model of an electric power system including a supply line of distributed parameters, transformers operating in parallel to both sides of the line, and other parts of the electric power system is proposed. Use of a modified Hamilton-Ostrogradsky principle as an interdisciplinary approach extends the range of variation approaches to dynamic systems analysis of both concentrated and distributed parameters.

articleTitle: Electromechanical oscillatory processes analysis in high voltage switch in power grid
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents a mathematical model of electric energy transmission. This model consists of two groups of transformers working in parallel, connected by a power line. High-voltage switches are used in the line. The mathematical model was created based on the interdisciplinary, modified Hamilton-Ostrogradsky principle. The analysis concerns the contact movement of the high voltage switch in the mathematical model of the system. Electromechanical oscillatory processes in the switch are analysed as well as electromagnetic waveforms in the elements of the electrical system. Complex phenomena are analysed in one energy model containing the mechanical and electrical description of the system. The use of the mathematical model of the switch contact mechanism allows for the consideration of oscillatory mechanical processes, which is important in the study of transient switching electromagnetic processes. The results of the computer simulation are presented.

articleTitle: The impact of the difficulty of the office logical task on the level of employee mental involvement
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: Determination of the influence of the type and length of activity related to intellectual work on the mental fatigue of a person and its relationship with the heart rate reserve. The scope of the research included an estimation of mental weariness determined on the basis of the number of incorrectly provided answers in the logical task. During mental work, the number of heartbeats was measured on the basis of which the WRT indicator has been determined. During the experiment,there were also tested the level of mental involvement and the level of concentration during mental work with the help of the Emotiv Epoc + neuroheter.. There was a significant relationship of results between the methods used and the number of errors made in the logical task in the case of a high degree of psychological burden. It has been noted that the psychological load during the analysis of scientific research has a very stable course, oscillating between 60% and 70% of the maximum human potential. This indicates a high predictability of fatigue level, which gives the opportunity to build a precise structure ofworking time to optimize employee performance..

articleTitle: Analysis of disturbance time in UPS operation
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The article presents the results of tests of UPSs regarding switching time of the power source. In this way, an attempt was made to answer the question whether the uninterruptible power supply (UPS) actually provides continuous power supply, or is there a minimal break in the power supply, e.g., “invisible” for the receiver? In the summary, the functional features of an ideal UPS are proposed, as well as an ideal off-line and on-line UPS.

articleTitle: An Influence of Design Parameters on Dynamic and Static Behaviour of Brushless DC Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: In the paper the brushless DC motor units, including stator winding and electronic commutation circuit, are studied. Two types of stator winding, i.e. three-phase winding connected in star fashion and five-phase winding connected in pentagonal fashion, are considered in the studies. The influence of design parameters on dynamic and static behaviour of the motors is taken into account. Mathematical models of the respective structures are formulated and the results of computer simulation are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Generalizations of Arbelos and Their Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: An arbelos is a plane figure bounded by three semicircles that are pairwise tangent and have diameters lying on the same line. Its name comes from Greek and means Shoemaker's knife. Similar shape have the lines of magnetic field distribution in ideal form for two parallel wires. The paper presents the discussion on the parabolic analogue of arbelos and their theoretical contributions in electrical engineering.

articleTitle: Implementation of modified image reconstruction algorithms in electrical tomography
publicationTitle: 2018 Applications of Electromagnetics in Modern Techniques and Medicine (PTZE)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: image reconstruction; electromagnetic fields; tomography; quality control; electric impedance imaging; medical image processing; nondestructive testing; patient treatment; inverse problems; computerised tomography.
